data.one_liner: Extract coordinates, zoom, and place info from Google Maps URLs, with short‑URL expansion.
data.what_it_does: Parses various Google Maps URL formats to retrieve latitude, longitude, zoom level, and place name. Expands shortened URLs using HTTP requests and caches results. Supports batch processing and validation utilities.
use_when: You need to obtain location data from user‑provided Google Maps links
You want to handle short Google Maps URLs without manual expansion
Batch processing of many map URLs is required
avoid_when: You need real‑time map rendering or interactive maps
You require reverse geocoding or place details beyond what the URL provides
strengths: Built‑in LRU caching reduces network calls
Clear error handling with custom exceptions
weaknesses: Relies on network for short‑URL expansion
Only extracts data present in the URL, no additional place details
No support for map widgets or UI components

alternatives.name: geocoding
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides reverse geocoding and place details from coordinates, useful if you already have lat/lng instead of URLs
